name: What signs mean my bathroom needs repair before painting?

mainEntity.name: What signs mean my bathroom needs repair before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you see peeling paint, swollen trim, soft drywall, or recurring mildew, those issues should be fixed before painting. Painting over them usually hides the problem for a short time and makes the finish fail sooner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Peeling paint, mildew, swelling trim, or damaged drywall usually mean the bathroom needs repair and prep before any painting starts.
